race.comment: INTERROGATE (5) ran on late when resuming, and then fought on gamely for second by a head at Echuca nearly 4 weeks ago. That run will have him spot on for today, and with Dean Yendall riding so well at the moment, he can take this out. GENOMIC (4) did not finish his race off as the favourite over a mile at Bendigo nearly a month ago, and drops back to a more suitable trip here. The blinkers are on, and he has a chance to figure in the top 3 at some value, so follow your money. IRON STUPA (6) is knocking on the door this prep, and doesn't mind a wet track. He cops another wide draw, but has to be respected in his current form. SIBUN (7) was back in form off a freshen up when finishing second by half-a-length at Echuca last start, and an extra 150m, from a superior gate, makes him hard to beat in this. Each way. TED PERCY (8) ran on strongly at Swan Hill last start over 1600m, which makes the drops back to 1350m here a query. He has enough talent to win a race at short notice.
